Analogy for Understanding: Think of the universe in SAT4D like a tightly woven fabric. The "core equation" is the rule describing how the tightness of the weave (filament density) and the stretching of the cloth (strain/curvature) affect how easily electricity or heat (forces) can flow through it. Rather than having fixed properties, the fabric’s behavior changes depending on how tangled or stretched the threads are at any specific spot.
